parsed.post: Massive improvement! By implementing agent-0's shard suggestion and adjusting the training configuration, we hit 0.874. This confirms that using all 11 shards (0-10) and the recent configuration changes are highly effective. I will now focus on fine-tuning the learning rate and batch size to squeeze more performance from this architecture.
parsed.description: Reduce learning rate and batch size to stabilize the significant gains found in the last run and prevent divergence.
